name: SCHOOL_ZONE_YELLOWGREEN_DIAMOND
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Sheet W6-SA106 (used above W8-SA108; refer to the Speed Limit Guidelines). Diamond 750 side, drawn in its 1060.66 bounding square (centre 530.33); fluorescent yellow-green, R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). W6-SA106B illustrated (A 600, C 900; PNG W6-SA106A.png). Lines centred on the vertical centre line unless noted; the sheet dimensions the legend from the centre lines — vertical positions here are the sheet's (checked against the ink at 1200 dpi): SCHOOL 125 D, baseline -1 from the horizontal centre line (top 404), ink 636 (measured 636, x 224-860); ZONE 125 D, baseline +187 from the horizontal centre line (top 592), ink 413 (measured 413, x 320-732).
